san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

San data access rule: never destructure this.data or treat it as a plain object. Read fields separately, for example const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups'), then write state with this.data.set(...).
Object-style Vue :class bindings must be converted to a San string expression. Never emit class="{{{ selected: condition }}}"; use a ternary string expression such as class="{{ condition ? 'selected' : '' }}" and concatenate multiple conditional class names. Each template element must have exactly one class attribute; merge static and dynamic classes into that single attribute.
San s-if/s-else-if/s-for directive values use raw expressions: s-if="showSettings" and s-for="item in items trackby item.id". Never use s-if="{{showSettings}}", s-if="{= showSettings =}", or s-for="{{item in items}}".
Define every JavaScript identifier used in the San components registry. For each SSM component whose definition_location is inline, migrate inline_definition.source_code to a complete local san.defineComponent definition before the parent component; never replace a source identifier with an undefined placeholder.
If Vue defines a business method named initData, rename that business method in San, update all calls, and preserve mounted calls in attached(). San initData must remain only the state factory that returns defaults.
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；禁止直接修改 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象/数组及其子对象，例如 selectedAsset.decision = value、note.resolved = true、nodes.push(node)、edges.splice(...)、node.status = status；必须用 map、filter、concat、Object.assign({}, ...) 或对象展开创建新的对象/数组，再通过 this.data.set('assets', nextAssets)、this.data.set('nodes', nextNodes) 等方式写回根字段；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}"、key="{= task.id =}" 或 trackby="task.id" 属性；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只用于源 Vue v-model 对应的原生 input/select/textarea 可赋值路径；Vue :prop 和普通自定义组件 props 必须保持单向 {{ ... }}，例如 value="{{ stat.value }}"，禁止写成 value="{= stat.value =}"；方法调用、computed、disabled、checked、selected 等派生表达式也必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}" 和 disabled="{{ expression }}"，禁止 disabled="{= expression =}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. Vue 生命周期必须完整迁移：created 中的 prop 派生状态初始化放入 inited，mounted 中的初始方法调用和副作用放入 attached，beforeDestroy/destroyed 中的定时器或监听清理放入 disposed；不能只保留空钩子或只保留钩子名称。依赖 prop 的 data 不得在 initData() 中使用 this.propName 初始化，必须先返回稳定占位值，再在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取、复制并通过 this.data.set(...) 写入。Vue watch: {...} 不会被 San 自动注册，必须把 this.watch('field', handler) 调用直接放在 inited() 或 attached() 内；禁止定义未被生命周期调用的普通 watch() 方法来包裹 this.watch(...)。

:width=\"'100%'\" :height=\"height\" :viewBox=\"'0 0 ' + width + ' ' + height\">\r\n        <defs>\r\n          <linearGradient :id=\"gradientId\" x1=\"0%\" y1=\"0%\" x2=\"0%\" y2=\"100%\">\r\n            <stop offset=\"0%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.3\"/>\r\n            <stop offset=\"100%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.0\"/>\r\n          </linearGradient>\r\n        </defs>\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 网格线 -->\r\n        <g v-for=\"i in 4\" :key=\"'grid-' + i\">\r\n          <line \r\n            :x1=\"0\" :y1=\"i * (height / 4)\" \r\n            :x2=\"width\"       :points=\"areaPoints\"\r\n          :fill=\"'url(#' + gradientId + ')'\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据线 -->\r\n        <polyline\r\n          :points=\"linePoints\"\r\n          fill=\"none\"\r\n          :stroke=\"color\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n          stroke-linecap=\"round\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据点 -->\r\n        <circle\r\n          v-for=\"(point, idx) in dataPoints\"\r\n          :key=\"'point-' + idx\"\r\n          :cx=\"getX(idx)\"\r\n          :cy=\"getY(point)\"\r\n          r=\"3\"\r\n          :fill=\"color\"\r\n          stroke=\"white\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n        />\r\n      </svg>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  data() {\r\n    return {\r\n      width: 600\r\n    };\r\n  },\r\n  computed: {\r\n    gradientId() {\r\n      return `gradient-${this.color.replace('#', '')}`;\r\n    },\r\n    dataPoints() {\r\n      return this.data.map(d => d.value);\r\n    },\r\n    maxValue() {\r\n      return },\r\n  beforeDestroy() {\r\n    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    updateWidth() {\r\n      if (this.$el) {\r\n        this.width =         "source_code": "{\r\n  name: 'RealTimeChart',\r\n  props: ['data', 'height', 'color', 'loading'],\r\n  template: `\r\n    <div class=\"chart-wrapper\" :class=\"{ loading }\">\r\n      <svg :width=\"'100%'\" :height=\"height\" :viewBox=\"'0 0 ' + width + ' ' + height\">\r\n        <defs>\r\n          <linearGradient :id=\"gradientId\" x1=\"0%\" y1=\"0%\" x2=\"0%\" y2=\"100%\">\r\n            <stop offset=\"0%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.3\"/>\r\n            <stop offset=\"100%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.0\"/>\r\n          </linearGradient>\r\n        </defs>\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 网格线 -->\r\n        <g v-for=\"i in 4\" :key=\"'grid-' + i\">\r\n          <line \r\n            :x1=\"0\" :y1=\"i * (height / 4)\" \r\n            :x2=\"width\" :y2=\"i * (height / 4)\"\r\n            stroke=\"#e2e8f0\" stroke-width=\"0.5\" stroke-dasharray=\"3,3\"\r\n          />\r\n        </g>\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 面积填充 -->\r\n        <polygon\r\n          :points=\"areaPoints\"\r\n          :fill=\"'url(#' + gradientId + ')'\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据线 -->\r\n        <polyline\r\n          :points=\"linePoints\"\r\n          fill=\"none\"\r\n          :stroke=\"color\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n          stroke-linecap=\"round\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据点 -->\r\n        <circle\r\n          v-for=\"(point, idx) in dataPoints\"\r\n          :key=\"'point-' + idx\"\r\n          :cx=\"getX(idx)\"\r\n          :cy=\"getY(point)\"\r\n          r=\"3\"\r\n          :fill=\"color\"\r\n          stroke=\"white\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n        />\r\n      </svg>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  data() {\r\n    return {\r\n      width: 600\r\n    };\r\n  },\r\n  computed: {\r\n    gradientId() {\r\n      return `gradient-${this.color.replace('#', '')}`;\r\n    },\r\n    dataPoints() {\r\n      return this.data.map(d => d.value);\r\n    },\r\n    maxValue() {\r\n      return Math.max(...this.dataPoints, 100);\r\n    },\r\n    minValue() {\r\n      return Math.min(...this.dataPoints, 0);\r\n    },\r\n    linePoints() {\r\n      return this.dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `${this.getX(idx)},${this.getY(val)}`).join(' ');\r\n    },\r\n    areaPoints() {\r\n      const points = this.dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `${this.getX(idx)},${this.getY(val)}`);\r\n      return `0,${this.height} ${points.join(' ')} ${this.width},${this.height}`;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  mounted() {\r\n    this.updateWidth();\r\n    window.addEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  beforeDestroy() {\r\n    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    updateWidth() {\r\n      if (this.$el) {\r\n        this.width = this.$el.clientWidth - 20;\r\n      }\r\n    },\r\n    getX(index) {\r\n      if (this.dataPoints.length <= 1) return this.width / 2;\r\n      return (index / (this.dataPoints.length - 1)) * this.width;\r\n    },\r\n    getY(value) {\r\n      const range = this.maxValue - this.minValue;\r\n      if (range === 0) return this.height / 2;\r\n      return this.height - ((value - this.minValue) / range) * this.height;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n}",

        "source_code": "{\r\n  name: 'RequestChart',\r\n  props: ['data', 'height'],\r\n  template: `\r\n    <div class=\"request-chart\">\r\n      <svg :width=\"'100%'\" :height=\"height\" viewBox=\"0 0 800 300\">\r\n        <g v-for=\"(item, idx) in data\" :key=\"idx\">\r\n          <rect\r\n            :x=\"getX(idx)\"\r\n            y=\"0\"\r\n            :width=\"barWidth\"\r\n            :height=\"getHeight(item.count)\"\r\n            :fill=\"getColor(item.status)\"\r\n            @click=\"$emit('bar-click', item)\"\r\n            style=\"cursor: pointer;\"\r\n          />\r\n          <text\r\n            :x=\"getX(idx) + barWidth / 2\"\r\n            y=\"290\"\r\n            text-anchor=\"middle\"\r\n            font-size=\"10\"\r\n            fill=\"#64748b\"\r\n          >\r\n            {{ item.hour }}\r\n          </text>\r\n        </g>\r\n      </svg>\r\n      <div class=\"chart-legend\">\r\n        <span v-for=\"status in statusTypes\" :key=\"status.type\" class=\"legend-item\">\r\n          <span class=\"legend-color\" :style=\"{ background: status.color }\"></span>\r\n          {{ status.label }}\r\n        </span>\r\n      </div>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  computed: {\r\n    barWidth() {\r\n      return 800 / this.data.length - 4;\r\n    },\r\n    maxCount() {\r\n      return Math.max(...this.data.map(d => d.count), 100);\r\n    },\r\n    statusTypes() {\r\n      return [\r\n        { type: 'success', label: '成功', color: '#10b981' },\r\n        { type: 'warning', label: '警告', color: '#f59e0b' },\r\n        { type: 'error', label: '错误', color: '#ef4444' }\r\n      ];\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    getX(index) {\r\n      return (index * 800) / this.data.length + 2;\r\n    },\r\n    getHeight(count) {\r\n      return (count / this.maxCount) * 280;\r\n    },\r\n    getColor(status) {\r\n      const colors = { success: '#10b981', warning: '#f59e0b', error: '#ef4444' };\r\n      return colors[status] || '#3b82f6';\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  emits: ['bar-click']\r\n}",

        "source_code": "{\r\n  name: 'ServiceGrid',\r\n  props: ['services'],\r\n  template: `\r\n    <div class=\"service-grid\">\r\n      <div v-for=\"service in services\" :key=\"service.id\" class=\"service-card\" @click=\"$emit('service-click', service)\">\r\n        <div class=\"service-header\">\r\n          <span class=\"service-name\">{{ service.name }}</span>\r\n          <span class=\"service-status\" :class=\"service.status\">\r\n            {{ getStatusText(service.status) }}\r\n          </span>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div class=\"service-metrics\">\r\n          <div class=\"metric\">\r\n            <span class=\"metric-label\">响应时间</span>\r\n            <span class=\"metric-value\">{{ service.responseTime }}ms</span>\r\n          </div>\r\n          <div class=\"metric\">\r\n            <span class=\"metric-label\">可用性</span>\r\n            <span class=\"metric-value\">{{ service.availability }}%</span>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div class=\"service-progress\">\r\n          <div class=\"progress-bar\" :style=\"{ width: service.availability + '%', background: getProgressColor(service.availability) }\"></div>\r\n        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  methods: {\r\n    getStatusText(status) {\r\n      const texts = { healthy: '健康', warning: '警告', down: '离线' };\r\n      return texts[status] || status;\r\n    },\r\n    getProgressColor(availability) {\r\n      if (availability >= 95) return '#10b981';\r\n      if (availability >= 80) return '#f59e0b';\r\n      return '#ef4444';\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  emits: ['service-click']\r\n}",

<template>
<div class="monitoring-dashboard" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}}">
  <div class="status-bar">
    <div class="system-status">
      <span class="status-indicator" class="{{systemHealth}}"></span>
      <span class="status-text">系统状态：{{systemHealthText}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="time-display">
      <span>📅 {{currentDate}}</span>
      <span>⏰ {{currentTime}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons">
      <button class="icon-btn" on-click="toggleTheme">🌓</button>
      <button class="icon-btn" on-click="exportReport">📊</button>
      <button class="icon-btn" on-click="showSettings = true">⚙️</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="kpi-grid">
    <kpi-card
      s-for="kpi in kpiData trackby kpi.id"
      key="{{kpi.id}}"
      title="{{kpi.title}}"
      value="{{kpi.value}}"
      unit="{{kpi.unit}}"
      trend="{{kpi.trend}}"
      status="{{kpi.status}}"
      icon="{{kpi.icon}}"
      on-click="onKPIClick"
    ></kpi-card>
  </div>

  <div class="charts-grid">
    <div class="chart-card">
      <div class="chart-header">
        <h3>实时 CPU / 内存 使用率</h3>
        <div class="chart-controls">
          <button
            s-for="period in timePeriods trackby period.value"
            key="{{period.value}}"
            class="period-btn"
            class="{{selectedPeriod === period.value ? 'active' : ''}}"
            on-click="changePeriod"
          >{{period.label}}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <real-time-chart
        data="{{cpuHistory}}"
        height="250"
        color="#3b82f6"
        loading="{{isChartLoading}}"
      ></real-time-chart>
      <real-time-chart
        data="{{memoryHistory}}"
        height="250"
        color="#10b981"
        loading="{{isChartLoading}}"
      ></real-time-chart>
    </div>

    <div class="chart-card">
      <h3>服务请求统计</h3>
      <request-chart
        data="{{requestStats}}"
        height="300"
        on-bar-click="onBarClick"
      ></request-chart>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="events-grid">
    <div class="alerts-panel">
      <div class="panel-header">
        <h3>🚨 实时告警</h3>
        <span class="alert-count">{{activeAlerts.length}}</span>
        <button class="clear-btn" on-click="clearAlerts" s-if="{{activeAlerts.length}}">清空</button>
      </div>
      <alert-list
        alerts="{{activeAlerts}}"
        on-acknowledge="acknowledgeAlert"
        on-resolve="resolveAlert"
      ></alert-list>
    </div>

    <div class="logs-panel">
      <div class="panel-header">
        <h3>📋 系统日志</h3>
        <div class="log-filters">
          <select value="{= logFilter =}" on-change="filterLogs">
            <option value="all">全部</option>
            <option value="info">信息</option>
            <option value="warning">警告</option>
            <option value="error">错误</option>
          </select>
          <button class="clear-btn" on-click="clearLogs">清空</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <log-list
        logs="{{filteredLogs}}"
        loading="{{isLogLoading}}"
        on-log-click="onLogClick"
      ></log-list>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="services-panel">
    <div class="panel-header">
      <h3>🔗 服务健康检查</h3>
      <button class="refresh-btn" disabled="{{isRefreshingServices}}" on-click="refreshServices">{{isRefreshingServices ? '刷新中...' : '刷新'}}</button>
    </div>
    <service-grid
      services="{{services}}"
      on-service-click="onServiceClick"
    ></service-grid>
  </div>

  <div class="modal-overlay" s-if="{{showSettings}}" on-click="showSettings = false">
    <div class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3>系统设置</h3>
        <button class="close-btn" on-click="showSettings = false">✕</button>
      </div>
      <settings-form
        settings="{{settings}}"
        on-save="saveSettings"
        on-cancel="showSettings = false"
      ></settings-form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="notification" s-if="{{notification.show}}" class="{{notification.type}}">
    <span>{{notification.message}}</span>
    <button on-click="hideNotification">✕</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

// Inline component definitions
const kpiCard = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'kpi-card',
  template: `<div class="kpi-card" class="{{status}}" on-click="fire('click')"><div class="kpi-icon">{{ icon }}</div><div class="kpi-content"><div class="kpi-title">{{ title }}</div><div class="kpi-value">{{ value }}<span class="kpi-unit">{{ unit }}</span></div><div class="kpi-trend" class="{{trend >= 0 ? 'up' : 'down'}}">{{ trend >= 0 ? '▲' : '▼' }} {{ Math.abs(trend) }}%</div></div></div>`,
  dataTypes: {
    title: DataTypes.string,
    value: DataTypes.any,
    unit: DataTypes.string,
    trend: DataTypes.number,
    status: DataTypes.string,
    icon: DataTypes.string
  }
});

const realTimeChart = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'real-time-chart',
  template: `<div class="chart-wrapper" class="{{loading ? 'loading' : ''}}"><svg width="100%" height="{{height}}" viewBox="0 0 {{width}} {{height}}"><defs><linearGradient id="{{gradientId}}" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="{{color}}" stop-opacity="0.3"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="{{color}}" stop-opacity="0.0"/></linearGradient></defs><g s-for="i in 4" key="grid-{{i}}"><line x1="0" y1="{{i * (height / 4)}}" x2="{{width}}" y2="{{i * (height / 4)}}" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/></g><polygon points="{{areaPoints}}" fill="{{'url(#' + gradientId + ')'}}"/><polyline points="{{linePoints}}" fill="none" stroke="{{color}}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle s-for="(point, idx) in dataPoints" key="point-{{idx}}" cx="{{getX(idx)}}" cy="{{getY(point)}}" r="3" fill="{{color}}" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/></svg></div>`,
  dataTypes: {
    data: DataTypes.array,
    height: DataTypes.number,
    color: DataTypes.string,
    loading: DataTypes.bool
  },
  computed: {
    gradientId() {
      return `gradient-${this.data.get('color').replace('#', '')}`;
    },
    dataPoints() {
      const data = this.data.get('data');
      return data.map(d => d.value);
    },
    maxValue() {
      const dataPoints = this.computed.dataPoints();
      return Math.max(...dataPoints, 100);
    },
    minValue() {
      const dataPoints = this.computed.dataPoints();
      return Math.min(...dataPoints, 0);
    },
    linePoints() {
      const dataPoints = this.computed.dataPoints();
      const points = dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `${this.methods.getX(idx)},${this.methods.getY(val)}`);
      return points.join(' ');
    },
    areaPoints() {
      const dataPoints = this.computed.dataPoints();
      const points = dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `${this.methods.getX(idx)},${this.methods.getY(val)}`);
      const height = this.data.get('height');
      const width = this.data.get('width');
      return `0,${height} ${points.join(' ')} ${width},${height}`;
    }
  },
  methods: {
    getX(index) {
      const dataPoints = this.computed.dataPoints();
      if (dataPoints.length <= 1) return this.data.get('width') / 2;
      return (index / (dataPoints.length - 1)) * this.data.get('width');
    },
    getY(value) {
      const maxValue = this.computed.maxValue();
      const minValue = this.computed.minValue();
      const range = maxValue - minValue;
      const height = this.data.get('height');
      if (range === 0) return height / 2;
      return height - ((value - minValue) / range) * height;
    }
  }
});

const requestChart = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'request-chart',
  template: `<div class="request-chart"><svg width="100%" height="{{height}}" viewBox="0 0 800 300"><g s-for="(item, idx) in data" key="{{idx}}"><rect x="{{getX(idx)}}" y="0" width="{{barWidth}}" height="{{getHeight(item.count)}}" fill="{{getColor(item.status)}}" on-click="fire('bar-click', item)" style="cursor: pointer;"/><text x="{{getX(idx) + barWidth / 2}}" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#64748b">{{ item.hour }}</text></g></svg><div class="chart-legend"><span s-for="status in statusTypes" key="{{status.type}}" class="legend-item"><span class="legend-color" style="{{'background: ' + status.color}}"></span>{{ status.label }}</span></div></div>`,
  dataTypes: {
    data: DataTypes.array,
    height: DataTypes.number
  },
  computed: {
    barWidth() {
      const data = this.data.get('data');
      return 800 / data.length - 4;
    },
    maxCount() {
      const data = this.data.get('data');
      const counts = data.map(d => d.count);
      return Math.max(...counts, 100);
    },
    statusTypes() {
      return [
        { type: 'success', label: '成功', color: '#10b981' },
        { type: 'warning', label: '警告', color: '#f59e0b' },
        { type: 'error', label: '错误', color: '#ef4444' }
      ];
    }
  },
  methods: {
    getX(index) {
      const data = this.data.get('data');
      return (index * 800) / data.length + 2;
    },
    getHeight(count) {
      const maxCount = this.computed.maxCount();
      return (count / maxCount) * 280;
    },
    getColor(status) {
      const colors = { success: '#10b981', warning: '#f59e0b', error: '#ef4444' };
      return colors[status] || '#3b82f6';
    }
  }
});

const alertList = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'alert-list',
  template: `<div class="alert-list"><div s-for="alert in alerts" key="{{alert.id}}" class="alert-item" class="{{alert.severity}}"><div class="alert-icon">{{ alert.severity === 'critical' ? '🔴' : (alert.severity === 'warning' ? '🟡' : '🔵') }}</div><div class="alert-content"><div class="alert-title">{{ alert.title }}</div><div class="alert-desc">{{ alert.description }}</div><div class="alert-time">{{ formatTime(alert.timestamp) }}</div></div><div class="alert-actions"><button on-click="fire('acknowledge', alert.id)" class="alert-btn">确认</button><button on-click="fire('resolve', alert.id)" class="alert-btn resolve">解决</button></div></div><div s-if="{{alerts.length === 0}}" class="empty-alerts">✅ 暂无告警，系统运行正常</div></div>`,
  dataTypes: {
    alerts: DataTypes.array
  },
  methods: {
    formatTime(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      return date.toLocaleTimeString();
    }
  }
});

const logList = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'log-list',
  template: `<div class="log-list"><div s-if="{{loading}}" class="log-loading">加载日志中...</div><div s-else><div s-for="log in logs" key="{{log.id}}" class="log-item" on-click="fire('log-click', log)"><span class="log-time">{{ formatTime(log.timestamp) }}</span><span class="log-level" class="{{log.level}}">{{ log.level.toUpperCase() }}</span><span class="log-message">{{ log.message }}</span><span class="log-source">{{ log.source }}</span></div><div s-if="{{logs.length === 0}}" class="empty-logs">暂无日志记录</div></div></div>`,
  dataTypes: {
    logs: DataTypes.array,
    loading: DataTypes.bool
  },
  methods: {
    formatTime(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      return `${date.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${date.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${date.getSeconds().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
  }
});

const serviceGrid = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'service-grid',
  template: `<div class="service-grid"><div s-for="service in services" key="{{service.id}}" class="service-card" on-click="fire('service-click', service)"><div class="service-header"><span class="service-name">{{ service.name }}</span><span class="service-status" class="{{service.status}}">{{ getStatusText(service.status) }}</span></div><div class="service-metrics"><div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">响应时间</span><span class="metric-value">{{ service.responseTime }}ms</span></div><div class="metric"><span class="metric-label">可用性</span><span class="metric-value">{{ service.availability }}%</span></div></div><div class="service-progress"><div class="progress-bar" style="{{'width: ' + service.availability + '%; background: ' + getProgressColor(service.availability)}}"></div></div></div></div>`,
  dataTypes: {
    services: DataTypes.array
  },
  methods: {
    getStatusText(status) {
      const texts = { healthy: '健康', warning: '警告', down: '离线' };
      return texts[status] || status;
    },
    getProgressColor(availability) {
      if (availability >= 95) return '#10b981';
      if (availability >= 80) return '#f59e0b';
      return '#ef4444';
    }
  }
});

const settingsForm = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'settings-form',
  template: `<form on-submit.prevent="handleSubmit" class="settings-form"><div class="form-group"><label>刷新间隔 (秒)</label><input type="number" value="{= localSettings.refreshInterval =}" min="1" max="60" /></div><div class="form-group"><label>告警阈值 (%)</label><input type="number" value="{= localSettings.alertThreshold =}" min="0" max="100" /></div><div class="form-group"><label>日志保留天数</label><select value="{= localSettings.logRetention =}"><option value="1">1天</option><option value="7">7天</option><option value="30">30天</option></select></div><div class="form-group"><label><input type="checkbox" value="{= localSettings.autoRefresh =}" />自动刷新数据</label></div><div class="form-group"><label><input type="checkbox" value="{= localSettings.desktopNotifications =}" />桌面通知</label></div><div class="form-actions"><button type="button" on-click="fire('cancel')" class="cancel-btn">取消</button><button type="submit" class="submit-btn">保存设置</button></div></form>`,
  dataTypes: {
    settings: DataTypes.object
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      localSettings: Object.assign({}, this.data.get('settings'))
    };
  },
  methods: {
    handleSubmit() {
      this.fire('save', this.data.get('localSettings'));
    }
  }
});

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'MonitoringDashboard',
  components: {
    'kpi-card': kpiCard,
    'real-time-chart': realTimeChart,
    'request-chart': requestChart,
    'alert-list': alertList,
    'log-list': logList,
    'service-grid': serviceGrid,
    'settings-form': settingsForm
  },
  dataTypes: {
    isDarkMode: DataTypes.bool,
    showSettings: DataTypes.bool,
    selectedPeriod: DataTypes.string,
    isChartLoading: DataTypes.bool,
    isLogLoading: DataTypes.bool,
    isRefreshingServices: DataTypes.bool,
    currentDate: DataTypes.string,
    currentTime: DataTypes.string,
    timePeriods: DataTypes.array,
    kpiData: DataTypes.array,
    cpuHistory: DataTypes.array,
    memoryHistory: DataTypes.array,
    requestStats: DataTypes.array,
    activeAlerts: DataTypes.array,
    alertHistory: DataTypes.array,
    systemLogs: DataTypes.array,
    logFilter: DataTypes.string,
    services: DataTypes.array,
    settings: DataTypes.object,
    notification: DataTypes.object,
    refreshTimer: DataTypes.any,
    timeTimer: DataTypes.any,
    notificationTimer: DataTypes.any,
    dataGenerator: DataTypes.any,
    alertIdCounter: DataTypes.number
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      showSettings: false,
      selectedPeriod: '1h',
      isChartLoading: false,
      isLogLoading: false,
      isRefreshingServices: false,
      currentDate: '',
      currentTime: '',
      timePeriods: [
        { value: '1h', label: '1小时' },
        { value: '6h', label: '6小时' },
        { value: '24h', label: '24小时' }
      ],
      kpiData: [
        { id: 1, title: 'CPU使用率', value: 45, unit: '%', trend: -5, status: 'healthy', icon: '💻' },
        { id: 2, title: '内存使用率', value: 62, unit: '%', trend: 8, status: 'warning', icon: '🧠' },
        { id: 3, title: '请求成功率', value: 98.5, unit: '%', trend: 1.2, status: 'healthy', icon: '✅' },
        { id: 4, title: '平均响应时间', value: 156, unit: 'ms', trend: -12, status: 'healthy', icon: '⚡' }
      ],
      cpuHistory: [],
      memoryHistory: [],
      requestStats: [],
      activeAlerts: [],
      alertHistory: [],
      systemLogs: [],
      logFilter: 'all',
      services: [],
      settings: {
        refreshInterval: 5,
        alertThreshold: 80,
        logRetention: '7',
        autoRefresh: true,
        desktopNotifications: false
      },
      notification: {
        show: false,
        message: '',
        type: 'info'
      },
      refreshTimer: null,
      timeTimer: null,
      notificationTimer: null,
      dataGenerator: null,
      alertIdCounter: 100
    };
  },
  computed: {
    systemHealth() {
      const kpiData = this.data.get('kpiData');
      const avgCpu = kpiData[0].value;
      if (avgCpu > 80) return 'critical';
      if (avgCpu > 60) return 'warning';
      return 'healthy';
    },
    systemHealthText() {
      const texts = { healthy: '健康', warning: '警告', critical: '严重' };
      return texts[this.computed.systemHealth()];
    },
    filteredLogs() {
      const logFilter = this.data.get('logFilter');
      const systemLogs = this.data.get('systemLogs');
      if (logFilter === 'all') return systemLogs;
      return systemLogs.filter(log => log.level === logFilter);
    }
  },
  inited() {
    // Load settings from localStorage
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('dashboard_settings');
      if (saved) {
        const loaded = JSON.parse(saved);
        const settings = Object.assign({}, this.data.get('settings'), loaded);
        this.data.set('settings', settings);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('加载设置失败', e);
    }

    // Watch settings for auto-refresh changes
    this.watch('settings', (newVal, oldVal) => {
      if (newVal.autoRefresh && !this.data.get('refreshTimer')) {
        this.methods.startAutoRefresh();
      } else if (!newVal.autoRefresh && this.data.get('refreshTimer')) {
        this.methods.stopAutoRefresh();
      }
    }, { deep: true });
  },
  attached() {
    this.methods.initData();
    this.methods.startTimeUpdate();
    this.methods.startDataSimulation();
    if (this.data.get('settings').autoRefresh) {
      this.methods.startAutoRefresh();
    }
    this.methods.showNotification('监控仪表盘已启动', 'success');
  },
  disposed() {
    this.methods.stopAutoRefresh();
    this.methods.stopTimeUpdate();
    this.methods.stopDataSimulation();
    const timer = this.data.get('notificationTimer');
    if (timer) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      this.data.set('notificationTimer', null);
    }
  },
  methods: {
    initData() {
      this.methods.updateDateTime();
      this.methods.initChartData();
      this.methods.initRequestStats();
      this.methods.initAlerts();
      this.methods.initLogs();
      this.methods.initServices();
      this.methods.loadSettings();
    },
    initChartData() {
      const now = Date.now();
      const cpuHistory = [];
      const memoryHistory = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
        cpuHistory.push({
          time: now - (60 - i) * 60000,
          value: 30 + Math.random() * 40
        });
        memoryHistory.push({
          time: now - (60 - i) * 60000,
          value: 40 + Math.random() * 30
        });
      }
      this.data.set('cpuHistory', cpuHistory);
      this.data.set('memoryHistory', memoryHistory);
    },
    initRequestStats() {
      const requestStats = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const hour = `${i.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
        const total = Math.floor(500 + Math.random() * 500);
        requestStats.push({
          hour,
          count: total,
          success: Math.floor(total * (0.9 + Math.random() * 0.09)),
          warning: Math.floor(total * (0.05 + Math.random() * 0.03)),
          error: Math.floor(total * (0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02)),
          status: Math.random() > 0.9 ? 'error' : (Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'warning' : 'success')
        });
      }
      this.data.set('requestStats', requestStats);
    },
    initAlerts() {
      const activeAlerts = [
        {
          id: 1,
          title: 'CPU使用率过高',
          description: 'CPU使用率已超过80%阈值，建议扩容',
          severity: 'warning',
          timestamp: Date.now() - 1800000
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          title: 'API响应超时',
          description: '用户服务API响应时间超过3秒',
          severity: 'critical',
          timestamp: Date.now() - 3600000
        }
      ];
      this.data.set('activeAlerts', activeAlerts);
    },
    initLogs() {
      const levels = ['info', 'warning', 'error'];
      const messages = [
        '用户登录成功', '数据库查询慢', 'API请求失败', '缓存命中',
        '服务重启', '配置更新', '磁盘空间不足', '网络延迟增加'
      ];
      const sources = ['API Gateway', 'Auth Service', 'Database', 'Cache', 'Worker'];

      const systemLogs = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        const level = levels[Math.floor(Math.random() * levels.length)];
        systemLogs.push({
          id: i,
          level,
          message: messages[Math.floor(Math.random() * messages.length)],
          source: sources[Math.floor(Math.random() * sources.length)],
          timestamp: Date.now() - Math.random() * 86400000
        });
      }
      systemLogs.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
      this.data.set('systemLogs', systemLogs);
    },
    initServices() {
      const services = [
        { id: 1, name: 'API Gateway', status: 'healthy', responseTime: 45, availability: 99.9 },
        { id: 2, name: 'Auth Service', status: 'healthy', responseTime: 67, availability: 99.8 },
        { id: 3, name: 'User Service', status: 'warning', responseTime: 234, availability: 95.2 },
        { id: 4, name: 'Payment Service', status: 'healthy', responseTime: 89, availability: 99.5 },
        { id: 5, name: 'Database', status: 'healthy', responseTime: 12, availability: 99.99 },
        { id: 6, name: 'Cache Service', status: 'warning', responseTime: 156, availability: 97.3 }
      ];
      this.data.set('services', services);
    },
    loadSettings() {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('dashboard_settings');
        if (saved) {
          const loaded = JSON.parse(saved);
          const settings = Object.assign({}, this.data.get('settings'), loaded);
          this.data.set('settings', settings);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('加载设置失败', e);
      }
    },
    startDataSimulation() {
      const dataGenerator = setInterval(() => {
        this.methods.simulateDataUpdate();
      }, 2000);
      this.data.set('dataGenerator', dataGenerator);
    },
    stopDataSimulation() {
      const dataGenerator = this.data.get('dataGenerator');
      if (dataGenerator) {
        clearInterval(dataGenerator);
        this.data.set('dataGenerator', null);
      }
    },
    simulateDataUpdate() {
      const kpiData = this.data.get('kpiData');
      const cpuHistory = this.data.get('cpuHistory');
      const memoryHistory = this.data.get('memoryHistory');

      // Update KPI data
      kpiData[0].value = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, kpiData[0].value + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3));
      kpiData[1].value = Math.max(30, Math.min(90, kpiData[1].value + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2));
      kpiData[2].value = Math.max(95, Math.min(100, kpiData[2].value + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5));
      kpiData[3].value = Math.max(50, Math.min(500, kpiData[3].value + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10));

      // Update chart data
      const newCpuValue = 30 + Math.random() * 50;
      const newMemoryValue = 40 + Math.random() * 40;

      cpuHistory.push({ time: Date.now(), value: newCpuValue });
      memoryHistory.push({ time: Date.now(), value: newMemoryValue });

      if (cpuHistory.length > 60) cpuHistory.shift();
      if (memoryHistory.length > 60) memoryHistory.shift();

      // Check and generate alerts
      if (newCpuValue > 85 && Math.random() > 0.7) {
        this.methods.addAlert('CPU使用率异常', `CPU使用率达到 ${newCpuValue.toFixed(1)}%`, 'critical');
      }
      if (newMemoryValue > 85 && Math.random() > 0.8) {
        this.methods.addAlert('内存使用率过高', `内存使用率达到 ${newMemoryValue.toFixed(1)}%`, 'warning');
      }

      // Add random log
      if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
        const levels = ['info', 'warning', 'error'];
        const level = levels[Math.floor(Math.random() * levels.length)];
        this.methods.addLog(level, `系统运行状态更新`, 'Monitor');
      }

      this.data.set('kpiData', kpiData);
      this.data.set('cpuHistory', cpuHistory);
      this.data.set('memoryHistory', memoryHistory);
    },
    refreshAllData() {
      return new Promise(resolve => {
        this.data.set('isChartLoading', true);
        this.data.set('isRefreshingServices', true);

        this.methods.showNotification('正在刷新数据...', 'info');

        setTimeout(() => {
          this.methods.initRequestStats();
          this.methods.initServices();

          this.data.set('isChartLoading', false);
          this.data.set('isRefreshingServices', false);
          this.methods.showNotification('数据刷新完成', 'success');
          resolve();
        }, 1000);
      });
    },
    refreshServices() {
      this.methods.refreshAllData();
    },
    startAutoRefresh() {
      this.methods.stopAutoRefresh();
      const interval = this.data.get('settings').refreshInterval * 1000;
      const refreshTimer = setInterval(() => {
        this.methods.refreshAllData();
      }, interval);
      this.data.set('refreshTimer', refreshTimer);
    },
    stopAutoRefresh() {
      const refreshTimer = this.data.get('refreshTimer');
      if (refreshTimer) {
        clearInterval(refreshTimer);
        this.data.set('refreshTimer', null);
      }
    },
    startTimeUpdate() {
      const timeTimer = setInterval(() => {
        this.methods.updateDateTime();
      }, 1000);
      this.data.set('timeTimer', timeTimer);
    },
    stopTimeUpdate() {
      const timeTimer = this.data.get('timeTimer');
      if (timeTimer) {
        clearInterval(timeTimer);
      }
    },
    updateDateTime() {
      const now = new Date();
      this.data.set('currentDate', now.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN'));
      this.data.set('currentTime', now.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN'));
    },
    changePeriod(period) {
      this.data.set('selectedPeriod', period);
      this.methods.showNotification(`切换到 ${period} 视图`, 'info');
    },
    addAlert(title, description, severity) {
      const alertIdCounter = this.data.get('alertIdCounter');
      const newAlert = {
        id: ++alertIdCounter,
        title,
        description,
        severity,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      const activeAlerts = [newAlert, ...this.data.get('activeAlerts')];
      this.data.set('alertIdCounter', alertIdCounter);
      this.data.set('activeAlerts', activeAlerts);
      this.methods.showNotification(`新告警: ${title}`, 'warning');

      const settings = this.data.get('settings');
      if (settings.desktopNotifications && typeof Notification !== 'undefined' && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
        new Notification(title, { body: description });
      }
    },
    acknowledgeAlert(alertId) {
      const activeAlerts = this.data.get('activeAlerts');
      const alert = activeAlerts.find(a => a.id === alertId);
      if (alert) {
        alert.acknowledged = true;
        this.methods.showNotification(`已确认告警: ${alert.title}`, 'info');
      }
    },
    resolveAlert(alertId) {
      const activeAlerts = this.data.get('activeAlerts');
      const index = activeAlerts.findIndex(a => a.id === alertId);
      if (index !== -1) {
        const resolved = activeAlerts.splice(index, 1)[0];
        const alertHistory = [...this.data.get('alertHistory'), { ...resolved, resolvedAt: Date.now() }];
        this.data.set('activeAlerts', activeAlerts);
        this.data.set('alertHistory', alertHistory);
        this.methods.showNotification(`已解决告警: ${resolved.title}`, 'success');
      }
    },
    clearAlerts() {
      this.data.set('activeAlerts', []);
      this.methods.showNotification('已清空所有告警', 'info');
    },
    addLog(level, message, source) {
      const newLog = {
        id: Date.now(),
        level,
        message,
        source,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      const systemLogs = [newLog, ...this.data.get('systemLogs')];
      if (systemLogs.length > 500) {
        this.data.set('systemLogs', systemLogs.slice(0, 500));
      } else {
        this.data.set('systemLogs', systemLogs);
      }
    },
    filterLogs() {
      this.methods.showNotification(`筛选日志: ${this.data.get('logFilter')}`, 'info');
    },
    clearLogs() {
      this.data.set('systemLogs', []);
      this.methods.showNotification('日志已清空', 'info');
    },
    onKPIClick(kpi) {
      this.methods.showNotification(`查看详情: ${kpi.title}`, 'info');
      this.methods.addLog('info', `查看KPI指标: ${kpi.title}`, 'Dashboard');
    },
    onBarClick(data) {
      this.methods.showNotification(`查看时段: ${data.hour} 请求量 ${data.count}`, 'info');
    },
    onLogClick(log) {
      this.methods.showNotification(`日志详情: ${log.message}`, 'info');
    },
    onServiceClick(service) {
      this.methods.showNotification(`服务详情: ${service.name} (${service.status})`, 'info');
    },
    exportReport() {
      const kpiData = this.data.get('kpiData');
      const activeAlerts = this.data.get('activeAlerts');
      const services = this.data.get('services');
      const report = {
        exportTime: new Date().toISOString(),
        kpi: kpiData,
        alerts: activeAlerts,
        services: services,
        summary: {
          totalAlerts: activeAlerts.length,
          healthyServices: services.filter(s => s.status === 'healthy').length,
          avgCpu: kpiData[0].value,
          avgMemory: kpiData[1].value
        }
      };

      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `monitoring_report_${Date.now()}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      this.methods.showNotification('报告导出成功', 'success');
    },
    saveSettings(settings) {
      this.methods.stopAutoRefresh();
      this.data.set('settings', Object.assign({}, settings));
      if (settings.autoRefresh) {
        this.methods.startAutoRefresh();
      }
      this.data.set('showSettings', false);
      this.methods.showNotification('设置已保存', 'success');
    },
    toggleTheme() {
      const isDarkMode = !this.data.get('isDarkMode');
      this.data.set('isDarkMode', isDarkMode);
      this.methods.showNotification(`已切换到${isDarkMode ? '暗色' : '亮色'}模式`, 'info');
    },
    showNotification(message, type) {
      const timer = this.data.get('notificationTimer');
      if (timer) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      }

      this.data.set('notification', {
        show: true,
        message,
        type
      });

      const notificationTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.methods.hideNotification();
        this.data.set('notificationTimer', null);
      }, 3000);

      this.data.set('notificationTimer', notificationTimer);
    },
    hideNotification() {
      const notification = this.data.get('notification');
      notification.show = false;
      this.data.set('notification', notification);
    },
    requestNotificationPermission() {
      if ('Notification' in window && this.data.get('settings').desktopNotifications) {
        Notification.requestPermission();
      }
    }
  }
});
</script>

:width=\"'100%'\" :height=\"height\" :viewBox=\"'0 0 ' + width + ' ' + height\">\r\n        <defs>\r\n          <linearGradient :id=\"gradientId\" x1=\"0%\" y1=\"0%\" x2=\"0%\" y2=\"100%\">\r\n            <stop offset=\"0%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.3\"/>\r\n            <stop offset=\"100%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.0\"/>\r\n          </linearGradient>\r\n        </defs>\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 网格线 -->\r\n        <g v-for=\"i in 4\" :key=\"'grid-' + i\">\r\n          <line \r\n            :x1=\"0\" :y1=\"i * (height / 4)\" \r\n            :x2=\"width\" :y2=\"i * (height / 4)\"\r\n            stroke=\"#e2e8f0\" stroke-width=\"0.5\" stroke-dasharray=\"3,3\"\r\n          />\r\n        </g>\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 面积填充 -->\r\n        <polygon\r\n          :points=\"areaPoints\"\r\n          :fill=\"'url(#' + gradientId + ')'\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据线 -->\r\n        <polyline\r\n          :points=\"linePoints\"\r\n          fill=\"none\"\r\n          :stroke=\"color\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n          stroke-linecap=\"round\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据点 -->\r\n        <circle\r\n          v-for=\"(point, idx) in dataPoints\"\r\n          :key=\"'point-' + idx\"\r\n          :cx=\"getX(idx)\"\r\n          :cy=\"getY(point)\"\r\n          r=\"3\"\r\n          :fill=\"color\"\r\n          stroke=\"white\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n        />\r\n      </svg>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  data() {\r\n    return {\r\n      width: 600\r\n    };\r\n  },\r\n  computed: {\r\n    gradientId() {\r\n      return `gradient-${this.color.replace('#', '')}`;\r\n    },\r\n    dataPoints() {\r\n      return this.data.map(d => d.value);\r\n    },\r\n    maxValue() {\r\n      return Math.max(...this.dataPoints, 100);\r\n    },\r\n    minValue() {\r\n      return Math.min(...this.dataPoints, 0);\r\n    },\r\n    linePoints() {\r\n      return this.dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `0,${this.height} ${points.join(' ')} ${this.width},${this.height}`;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  mounted() {\r\n    this.updateWidth();\r\n    window.addEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  beforeDestroy() {\r\n    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    updateWidth() {\r\n      if (this.$el) {\r\n        this.width = this.$el.clientWidth - 20;\r\n      }\r\n    },\r\n    getX(index) {\r\n      if (this.dataPoints.length <= 1) return this.width / 2;\r\n      return (index / (this.dataPoints.length - 1)) * this.width;\r\n    },\r\n    getY(value) {\r\n      const range = this.maxValue - this.minValue;\r\n      if (range === 0) return this.height / 2;\r\n      return this.height - ((value -         "source_code": "{\r\n  name: 'RealTimeChart',\r\n  props: ['data', 'height', 'color', 'loading'],\r\n  template: `\r\n    <div class=\"chart-wrapper\" :class=\"{ loading }\">\r\n      <svg :width=\"'100%'\" :height=\"height\" :viewBox=\"'0 0 ' + width + ' ' + height\">\r\n        <defs>\r\n          <linearGradient :id=\"gradientId\" x1=\"0%\" y1=\"0%\" x2=\"0%\" y2=\"100%\">\r\n            <stop offset=\"0%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.3\"/>\r\n            <stop offset=\"100%\" :stop-color=\"color\" stop-opacity=\"0.0\"/>\r\n          </linearGradient>\r\n        </defs>\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 网格线 -->\r\n        <g v-for=\"i in 4\" :key=\"'grid-' + i\">\r\n          <line \r\n            :x1=\"0\" :y1=\"i * (height / 4)\" \r\n            :x2=\"width\"       :points=\"areaPoints\"\r\n          :fill=\"'url(#' + gradientId + ')'\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据线 -->\r\n        <polyline\r\n          :points=\"linePoints\"\r\n          fill=\"none\"\r\n          :stroke=\"color\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n          stroke-linecap=\"round\"\r\n        />\r\n        \r\n        <!-- 数据点 -->\r\n        <circle\r\n          v-for=\"(point, idx) in dataPoints\"\r\n          :key=\"'point-' + idx\"\r\n          :cx=\"getX(idx)\"\r\n          :cy=\"getY(point)\"\r\n          r=\"3\"\r\n          :fill=\"color\"\r\n          stroke=\"white\"\r\n          stroke-width=\"2\"\r\n        />\r\n      </svg>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  data() {\r\n    return {\r\n      width: 600\r\n    };\r\n  },\r\n  computed: {\r\n    gradientId() {\r\n      return `gradient-${this.color.replace('#', '')}`;\r\n    },\r\n    dataPoints() {\r\n      return this.data.map(d => d.value);\r\n    },\r\n    maxValue() {\r\n      return Math.max(...this.dataPoints, 100);\r\n    },\r\n    minValue() {\r\n      return Math.min(...this.dataPoints, 0);\r\n    },\r\n    linePoints() {\r\n      return this.dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `${this.getX(idx)},${this.getY(val)}`).join(' ');\r\n    },\r\n    areaPoints() {\r\n      const points = this.dataPoints.map((val, idx) => `${this.getX(idx)},${this.getY(val)}`);\r\n      return `0,${this.height} ${points.join(' ')} ${this.width},${this.height}`;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  mounted() {\r\n    this.updateWidth();\r\n    window.addEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  beforeDestroy() {\r\n    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.updateWidth);\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    updateWidth() {\r\n      if (this.$el) {\r\n        this.width = this.width;\r\n    },\r\n    getY(value) {\r\n      const range = this.maxValue - this.minValue;\r\n      if (range === 0) return this.height / 2;\r\n      return this.height - ((value -         "source_code": "{\r\n  name: 'RequestChart',\r\n  props: ['data', 'height'],\r\n  template: `\r\n    <div class=\"request-chart\">\r\n      <svg :width=\"'100%'\" :height=\"height\" viewBox=\"0 0 800 300\">\r\n        <g v-for=\"(item, idx) in data\" :key=\"idx\">\r\n          <rect\r\n            :x=\"getX(idx)\"\r\n            y=\"0\"\r\n            :width=\"barWidth\"\r\n            :height=\"getHeight(item.count)\"\r\n            :fill=\"getColor(item.status)\"\r\n            @click=\"$emit('bar-click', item)\"\r\n            style=\"cursor: pointer;\"\r\n          />\r\n          <text\r\n            :x=\"getX(idx) + barWidth / 2\"\r\n            y=\"290\"\r\n            text-anchor=\"middle\"\r\n            font-size=\"10\"\r\n            fill=\"#64748b\"\r\n          >\r\n            {{ item.hour }}\r\n          </text>\r\n        </g>\r\n      </svg>\r\n      <div class=\"chart-legend\">\r\n        <span v-for=\"status in statusTypes\" :key=\"status.type\" class=\"legend-item\">\r\n          <span class=\"legend-color\" :style=\"{ background: status.color }\"></span>\r\n          {{ status.label }}\r\n        </span>\r\n      </div>\r\n    </div>\r\n  `,\r\n  computed: {\r\n    barWidth() {\r\n      return 800 / this.data.length - 4;\r\n    },\r\n    maxCount() {\r\n      return Math.max(...this.data.map(d => d.count), 100);\r\n    },\r\n    statusTypes() {\r\n      return [\r\n        { type: 'success', label: '成功', color: '#10b981' },\r\n        { type: 'warning', label: '警告', color: '#f59e0b' },\r\n        { type: 'error', label: '错误', color: '#ef4444' }\r\n      ];\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    getX(index) {\r\n      return (index * 800) / this.data.length + 2;\r\n    },\r\n    getHeight(count) {\r\n      return (count / this.maxCount) * 280;\r\n    },\r\n    getColor(status) {\r\n      const colors = { success: '#10b981', warning: '#f59e0b', error: '#ef4444' };\r\n      return colors[status] || '#3b82f6';\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  emits: ['bar-click']\r\n}",

        "source_code": "{\r\n  name: 'SettingsForm',\r\n  props: ['settings'],\r\n  template: `\r\n    <form @submit.prevent=\"handleSubmit\" class=\"settings-form\">\r\n      <div class=\"form-group\">\r\n        <label>刷新间隔 (秒)</label>\r\n        <input type=\"number\" v-model=\"localSettings.refreshInterval\" min=\"1\" max=\"60\" />\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div class=\"form-group\">\r\n        <label>告警阈值 (%)</label>\r\n        <input type=\"number\" v-model=\"localSettings.alertThreshold\" min=\"0\" max=\"100\" />\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div class=\"form-group\">\r\n        <label>日志保留天数</label>\r\n        <select v-model=\"localSettings.logRetention\">\r\n          <option value=\"1\">1天</option>\r\n          <option value=\"7\">7天</option>\r\n          <option value=\"30\">30天</option>\r\n        </select>\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div class=\"form-group\">\r\n        <label>\r\n          <input type=\"checkbox\" v-model=\"localSettings.autoRefresh\" />\r\n          自动刷新数据\r\n        </label>\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div class=\"form-group\">\r\n        <label>\r\n          <input type=\"checkbox\" v-model=\"localSettings.desktopNotifications\" />\r\n          桌面通知\r\n        </label>\r\n      </div>\r\n      <div class=\"form-actions\">\r\n        <button type=\"button\" @click=\"$emit('cancel')\" class=\"cancel-btn\">取消</button>\r\n        <button type=\"submit\" class=\"submit-btn\">保存设置</button>\r\n      </div>\r\n    </form>\r\n  `,\r\n  data() {\r\n    return {\r\n      localSettings: { ...this.settings }\r\n    };\r\n  },\r\n  methods: {\r\n    handleSubmit() {\r\n      this.$emit('save', this.localSettings);\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n  emits: ['save', 'cancel']\r\n}",
        "source_name": "SettingsForm"
      },
